lean.statement:
example {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] {f : E → ℝ} {G : NNReal} {x g : ℕ → E} {a : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hf : LipschitzWith G f) (ha : ∀ k, 0 < a k)
    (hs : ∀ k, SupportsAt f (x k) (g k))
    (hx : ∀ k, x (k + 1) = x k - a k • g k) (z : E) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    ∃ i < N, f (x i) - f z ≤
      (‖x 0 - z‖ ^ 2 + (G : ℝ) ^ 2 * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (a k) ^ 2)) /
        (2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, a k)
approved_definition_context: NNReal is the type of nonnegative real numbers, coerced to real when necessary.
SupportsAt F p v abbreviates ∀ z, F p + inner ℝ v (z - p) ≤ F z. This is a pointwise inequality on the whole carrier, not a derivative or a chosen optimizer.
The norm and inner product are those of the indicated real inner-product space. Finset.range N consists of natural indices smaller than N; the displayed sums are finite real sums.
